title: Create Combined+
description: This Project is a personal take on the Create Combined Pack but Updated to the latest versions
body:
This is a hand made update to the [Create Combined](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-combined) modpack. Ive taken time to update and fix compatibility issues for the latest version of Create, and the Latest version of the game, this took me some time to do, because of dependancy errors, and ive even added more mods to give people some more fun building factories.

Ive added mods such as AE2, Sophisticated Backpacks/Storage, and FTB Ultimine. and many more to the original mod pack.

E4mc is instaled for easy multiplayer with friends.

Disclamer: the original modpack was made for fabric, this modpack is ade for NeoForge, there will be differences that cant be changed. Please dont send LegendarySpy bugs and issues because this Modpack has no relation to him/her what so ever.
